back: Plant of the pea and bean family: seeds in pods, root nodules with nitrogen-fixing Rhizobium.
Coating legume seed with the correct Rhizobium bacteria so that effective nodules form.
Supplies calcium to the pegging zone at early flowering; without it many pods are empty (pops).
Keep cool, mix with seed in the shade, avoid fertiliser and some seed dressings, plant the same day.

front: Which mould poison affects damp groundnuts?
back: Aflatoxin, from Aspergillus moulds; dry pods quickly, pods up, off the soil.
Mass of kernels ÷ mass of pods × 100.
Groundnut rosette (aphids), leaf spots, soya rust, bean stem maggot, bacterial blight, bruchids in store.
Fix nitrogen for the next cereal and break cereal pest and disease cycles.
Spanish: erect, early, little seed dormancy. Virginia: spreading, longer season, dormant seed.
